rationale_md: Morocco enters this Group C encounter as the clear favorite, backed by a 150-point Elo rating advantage over Scotland that reflects their superior recent form and competitive pedigree. The North African side's 43% win probability in our model significantly outpaces Scotland's 33% chance, suggesting the Atlas Lions should control proceedings at Commonwealth Stadium. Scotland will need to overcome both the statistical disadvantage and Morocco's technical quality to secure a result in what shapes up as a challenging group stage opener.
